name: Amp Chantant
description: Virtuose de la Résonance créant des boucles de feedback destructrices visant les armures et les équipements sensibles aux vibrations.

subject.archetype: Amp Chantant — Chœur Synthétique Epic class reseau

loadout.armor_outfit: Crystalline armor plates growing naturally from body vibrating at resonant frequencies with visible sound waves emanating from every surface, each facet catching and fracturing light into rainbows, organic-metal hybrid construction forged from rare materials with faction crest embedded and energy pulsing through the entire surface with every movement
loadout.arsenal: Resonance tuning fork weapon humming at visible destructive frequency with air distortion around it, harmonic shield gauntlet generating visible ring-shaped sound wave barriers, crystalline conductor baton emitting visible vibration patterns The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's growing ability targeting adjacent_enemy, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Predatory lunge forward with hand extended like claw toward enemy with focused targeted red energy tendrils erupting from fingertips burrowing into enemy to siphon their strength
attitude.emotion: Apocalyptic fury — full weight of faction's power channeling through body uncontrollably

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Violet Crystal
palette_names.role: primary_accent — resonance energy beams and crystal shards

palette_names.name: Silver Prismatic
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — sound wave visualization and reflections

palette_names.name: Deep Indigo
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — shockwave shadows and deep resonance tones

color_and_light.lighting_setup: amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing light along border edges, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Wide dramatic low angle showing full blast radius, character backlit by their own power source, foreground devastated by ability effects

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater turned battlefield with crystal formations exploding from harmonic overload sending shards every direction, visible shockwave rings tearing through enemy positions, fragments raining from resonating cracked ceiling structures, entire environment vibrating at a frequency that makes air appear to ripple and distort
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Visible power drain with red tendrils burrowing into enemy and flowing stolen energy back to caster, enemy position visibly weakening and dimming as power is stolen and converted, Ground between caster and enemy withering as parasitic energy transfer corrupts everything in path, siphoned energy creating visible trail of corruption on return to caster, Visible concentric sound waves expanding outward shattering nearby crystal structures into cascading shards, crystal fragments flying through air catching prismatic light, air visibly rippling and bending from sonic force, ground fracturing in geometric patterns from bass, floating debris suspended in harmonic stasis field
